entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalApply_mul

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra E L] (M N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (q : L), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator (M * N) q = (algebraMap E L) (M 1 0) * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator N q + (algebraMap E L) (M 1 1) * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator N q

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator_mul_factor
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra E L] (M N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (q : L), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator N q ≠ 0 → PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator (M * N) q = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator N q * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator M (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalApply N q)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator_mul_ne_zero

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra E L] (c : E) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (q : L), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator (c • M) q = (algebraMap E L) c * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator M q

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra E L] (M N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (q : L), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator (M * N) q = (algebraMap E L) (M 0 0) * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator N q + (algebraMap E L) (M 0 1) * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator N q

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator_mul_factor
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra E L] (M N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (q : L), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator N q ≠ 0 → PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator (M * N) q = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator N q * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator M (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalApply N q)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra E L] (c : E) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (q : L), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator (c • M) q = (algebraMap E L) c * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalNumerator M q

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedEquiv

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedPermutation_external_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} {de ab : Fin m × Fin m} (σ : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.MatchingBitCrossSelectedPermutation ell m de ab) (y : { y // y ∉ PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCoefficientSet ell m de }) (j : Fin m), ↑↑σ ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inl ↑y)) = (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr j) → j ≠ ab.2

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedPermutation_weight
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} (p q : Fin m → ℂ) (de ab : Fin m × Fin m) (σ : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.MatchingBitCrossSelectedPermutation ell m de ab), ∏ i, (MvPolynomial.eval (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPermanentSpecialization p q)) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPermutationOutsideFactor (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingDiagonalEmbedding ell m) ↑↑σ ↑i) = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingCrossWeight p q (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.1) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.2) ab.1 ab.2 (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedToCross σ)

entries.statement: {ell m : ℕ} → {de ab : Fin m × Fin m} → PermanentFormulaLowerBound.MatchingBitCrossSelectedPermutation ell m de ab → ↥(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.1) ⊕ ↥(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.2) ↪ Fin (ell + ell + m)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedSupportEmbedding_factor
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} (p q : Fin m → ℂ) {de ab : Fin m × Fin m} (σ : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.MatchingBitCrossSelectedPermutation ell m de ab) (t : ↥(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.1) ⊕ ↥(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.2)), (MvPolynomial.eval (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPermanentSpecialization p q)) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPermutationOutsideFactor (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingDiagonalEmbedding ell m) (↑↑σ) ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedSupportEmbedding σ) t)) = match t with | Sum.inl u => p ↑((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingCrossRows (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedToCross σ)) (Sum.inl u)) ^ 2 ^ ↑↑u | Sum.inr v => q ↑((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingCrossCols (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedToCross σ)) (Sum.inr v)) ^ 2 ^ ↑↑v

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedToCross
entries.statement: {ell m : ℕ} → {de ab : Fin m × Fin m} → PermanentFormulaLowerBound.MatchingBitCrossSelectedPermutation ell m de ab → PermanentFormulaLowerBound.MatchingCrossPermutation (↥(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.1) ⊕ ↥(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.2)) { j // j ≠ ab.1 } { j // j ≠ ab.2 }

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitCrossSelectedToCross_toSelected

entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing F] {ell m : ℕ} (p : Fin m → F) (P : Finset (Fin ell)) (b : Fin m), Polynomial.eval (p b) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPolynomial p P) = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingAvoidingInjectionSum p P b

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPolynomial_natDegree
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] [CharZero F] {ell m : ℕ} (p : Fin m → F) (P : Finset (Fin ell)), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPolynomial p P).natDegree = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBinaryDegree P

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPolynomial_natDegree_le
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing F] [Nontrivial F] {ell m : ℕ} (p : Fin m → F) (P : Finset (Fin ell)), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPolynomial p P).natDegree ≤ PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBinaryDegree P

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPolynomial_of_nonempty
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing F] {ell m : ℕ} (p : Fin m → F) (P : Finset (Fin ell)), P.Nonempty → PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPolynomial p P = Polynomial.C (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingInjectionSum p P) - ∑ u, Polynomial.X ^ 2 ^ ↑↑u * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingPolynomial p (P.erase ↑u)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingReducedEquiv
entries.statement: {ell m : ℕ} → (S : Finset (Fin ell ⊕ Fin ell)) → (a b : Fin m) → (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (ell + ell + m))) → (∀ y ∈ S, σ ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inl y)) = (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inl y)) → σ ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr a)) = (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr b) → { y // y ∉ S } ⊕ { j // j ≠ a } ≃ { y // y ∉ S } ⊕ { j // j ≠ b }

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingReducedEquiv_eq_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin ell ⊕ Fin ell)) (a b : Fin m) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (ell + ell + m))) (hfix : ∀ y ∈ S, σ ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inl y)) = (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inl y)) (hab : σ ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr a)) = (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr b)) (x : { y // y ∉ S } ⊕ { j // j ≠ a }) (y : { y // y ∉ S } ⊕ { j // j ≠ b }), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingReducedEquiv S a b σ hfix hab) x = y ↔ σ ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingRemainingIndexEmbedding (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) S a) x) = (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingRemainingIndexEmbedding (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) S b) y

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingReducedEquiv_extend
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin ell ⊕ Fin ell)) (a b : Fin m) (τ : { y // y ∉ S } ⊕ { j // j ≠ a } ≃ { y // y ∉ S } ⊕ { j // j ≠ b }), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingReducedEquiv S a b (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingExtendReducedEquiv S a b τ) ⋯ ⋯ = τ

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingRemainingIndexEmbedding
entries.statement: {Y : Type u_1} → {E : Type u_2} → {I : Type u_3} → Y ⊕ E ≃ I → (S : Finset Y) → (a : E) → { y // y ∉ S } ⊕ { j // j ≠ a } ↪ I

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingRemainingIndexEmbedding_range
entries.statement: ∀ {Y : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (e : Y ⊕ E ≃ I) (S : Finset Y) (a : E), Set.range ⇑(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingRemainingIndexEmbedding e S a) = (Set.range ⇑(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingDeletedIndexEmbedding e S a))ᶜ

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingRemainingIndexEquiv
entries.statement: {Y : Type u_1} → {E : Type u_2} → {I : Type u_3} → (e : Y ⊕ E ≃ I) → (S : Finset Y) → (a : E) → { y // y ∉ S } ⊕ { j // j ≠ a } ≃ { i // i ∉ Set.range ⇑(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingDeletedIndexEmbedding e S a) }

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingRestrictComplement
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → {D : Type u_3} → (e : α ≃ β) → (r : D ↪ α) → (c : D ↪ β) → (∀ (d : D), e (r d) = c d) → { x // x ∉ Set.range ⇑r } ≃ { y // y ∉ Set.range ⇑c }

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingSquarefreeMonomial
entries.statement: {Y : Type u} → Finset Y → Y →₀ ℕ

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingSquarefreeMonomial_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {Y : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Y] (S : Finset Y) (y : Y), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingSquarefreeMonomial S) y = if y ∈ S then 1 else 0

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → {Y : Type u} → (d : Y ↪ Fin n × Fin n) → Y ⊕ PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingOutside d ≃ Fin n × Fin n

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv_inl
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {Y : Type u} (d : Y ↪ Fin n × Fin n) (y : Y), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv d) (Sum.inl y) = d y

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv_inr
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {Y : Type u} (d : Y ↪ Fin n × Fin n) (z : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingOutside d), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv d) (Sum.inr z) = ↑z

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv_relabel_commutes
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {Y : Type u} (d₀ d : Y ↪ Fin n × Fin n) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n × Fin n)) (he : ∀ (y : Y), e (d₀ y) = d y), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv d₀).symm.trans ((Equiv.refl Y).sumCongr (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingOutsideRelabelEquiv d₀ d e he)) = Equiv.trans e (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv d).symm

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv_symm_marked
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {Y : Type u} (d : Y ↪ Fin n × Fin n) (y : Y), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingVariableEquiv d).symm (d y) = Sum.inl y

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedBivariateBitEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] [CharZero F] {ell m : ℕ} (p q : Fin m → F), Function.Injective p → Function.Injective q → m ≤ 2 ^ ell → 2 * ell < m → (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedBivariateEvaluationMatrix p q (fun d => PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑d) fun e => PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑e).det ≠ 0

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedBivariateEvaluationMatrix
entries.statement: {F : Type u_1} → [CommRing F] → {ell m : ℕ} → (Fin m → F) → (Fin m → F) → (Fin m → Finset (Fin ell)) → (Fin m → Finset (Fin ell)) → Matrix (Fin m × Fin m) (Fin m × Fin m) F

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedBivariateEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] [CharZero F] {ell m : ℕ} (p q : Fin m → F), Function.Injective p → Function.Injective q → ∀ (P Q : Fin m → Finset (Fin ell)), (∀ (d : Fin m), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBinaryDegree (P d) = ↑d) → (∀ (e : Fin m), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBinaryDegree (Q e) = ↑e) → 2 * ell < m → (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedBivariateEvaluationMatrix p q P Q).det ≠ 0

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedBivariateEvaluationMatrix_eq_diagonal_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing F] {ell m : ℕ} (p q : Fin m → F) (P Q : Fin m → Finset (Fin ell)), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedBivariateEvaluationMatrix p q P Q = (Matrix.diagonal fun de => ↑(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingJacobianWeight m (P de.1).card (Q de.2).card)) * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBivariateEvaluationMatrix p q P Q

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedCrossBitPermutation_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing F] {ell m : ℕ} (p q : Fin m → F) (de ab : Fin m × Fin m), ∑ σ, PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingCrossWeight p q (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.1) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑de.2) ab.1 ab.2 σ = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingWeightedBivariateEvaluationMatrix p q (fun d => PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑d) (fun e => PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBitSubset ell ↑e) de ab

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_block_size_le_half
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → 2 * Nat.clog 2 n ≤ n / 2

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_card_compl_range
entries.statement: ∀ {T : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype T] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A] (f : T ↪ A), Fintype.card { a // a ∉ Set.range ⇑f } = Fintype.card A - Fintype.card T

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_card_omitted_external
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} (b : Fin m), Fintype.card { j // j ≠ b } = m - 1

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_card_residual_equiv
entries.statement: ∀ {T : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype T] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] (rows : T ↪ B) (cols : T ↪ A), Fintype.card A = Fintype.card B → Fintype.card ({ a // a ∉ Set.range ⇑cols } ≃ { b // b ∉ Set.range ⇑rows }) = (Fintype.card A - Fintype.card T).factorial

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_exists_hit
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} {P : Finset (Fin ell)} (b : Fin m) (rho : { rho // ¬∀ (u : ↥P), rho u ≠ b }), ∃ u, ↑rho u = b

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_external_external_not_mem_diagonal
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m), ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr a), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr b)) ∉ Set.range ⇑(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingDiagonalEmbedding ell m)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_external_internal_not_mem_diagonal
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} (a : Fin m) (y : Fin ell ⊕ Fin ell), ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr a), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inl y)) ∉ Set.range ⇑(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingDiagonalEmbedding ell m)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_external_size_ge_block_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → 2 * Nat.clog 2 n + 1 ≤ n - 2 * Nat.clog 2 n

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_external_size_le_two_pow
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, n - 2 * Nat.clog 2 n ≤ 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 n

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_internal_external_not_mem_diagonal
entries.statement: ∀ {ell m : ℕ} (y : Fin ell ⊕ Fin ell) (b : Fin m), ((PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inl y), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingBlockIndexEquiv ell m) (Sum.inr b)) ∉ Set.range ⇑(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingDiagonalEmbedding ell m)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_leftWeightedAvoidingInjectionSum
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring F] {ell m : ℕ} (p : Fin m → F) (P Q : Finset (Fin ell)) (b : Fin m), ∑ rho, ∏ u, p ↑(rho (Sum.inl u)) ^ 2 ^ ↑↑u = ↑((m - 1 - P.card).descFactorial Q.card) * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingAvoidingInjectionSum p P b

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matching_rightWeightedAvoidingInjectionSum
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring F] {ell m : ℕ} (q : Fin m → F) (P Q : Finset (Fin ell)) (a : Fin m), ∑ rho, ∏ v, q ↑(rho (Sum.inr v)) ^ 2 ^ ↑↑v = ↑((m - 1 - Q.card).descFactorial P.card) * PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingAvoidingInjectionSum q Q a

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matrix_ne_zero_of_fractionalDenominator_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra E L] (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (q : L), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.fractionalDenominator M q ≠ 0 → M ≠ 0

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.mem_matchingMarkedFinset

entries.statement: {E : Type u_1} → [Field E] → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E → Fin 2 × Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.normalizedFractionalMatrix_entry_mem_adjoin
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : Field E] {F : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2), M ij.1 ij.2 ≠ 0 → ∀ (a b : Fin 2), PermanentFormulaLowerBound.normalizedFractionalMatrix M ij a b ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin F ↑(PermanentFormulaLowerBound.projectiveMatrixGenerators M ij)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.normalizedFractionalMatrix_pivot
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : Field E] (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) (ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2), M ij.1 ij.2 ≠ 0 → PermanentFormulaLowerBound.normalizedFractionalMatrix M ij ij.1 ij.2 = 1

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.pderiv_aeval_chain_rule
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} {F : Type w} [inst : CommSemiring F] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (g : ι → MvPolynomial κ F) (H : MvPolynomial ι F) (j : κ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.aeval g) H) = ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.aeval g) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) H) * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (g i)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.pderiv_bind₁_chain_rule
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} {F : Type w} [inst : CommSemiring F] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (g : ι → MvPolynomial κ F) (H : MvPolynomial ι F) (j : κ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.bind₁ g) H) = ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.bind₁ g) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) H) * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (g i)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPermutationMonomial_pderiv
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a b : Fin n), (MvPolynomial.pderiv (a, b)) (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X (i, σ i)) = if σ a = b then ∏ i, MvPolynomial.X (↑i, σ ↑i) else 0

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial_pderiv_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n), (MvPolynomial.pderiv (a, b)) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n) = ∑ σ, if σ a = b then ∏ i, MvPolynomial.X (↑i, σ ↑i) else 0

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial_pderiv_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n), (MvPolynomial.pderiv (a, b)) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n) ≠ 0

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial_rename_prodCongr
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (r c : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ (Equiv.prodCongr r c)) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n) = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanent_divisionFree_formula_fourth_power_lower_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), f.eval = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n → n ^ 4 ≤ 32 * (2 * Nat.clog 2 n) * f.variableLeaves

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanent_divisionFree_formula_logarithmic_lower_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), f.eval = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n → ↑n ^ 4 / (128 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.variableLeaves

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanent_divisionFree_formula_lower_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), f.eval = PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n → ↑n ^ 4 / (128 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.variableLeaves ∧ ↑n ^ 4 / (128 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.leafCount ∧ ↑n ^ 4 / (128 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.vertexCount ∧ ↑n ^ 4 / (256 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.internalGateCount

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanent_rational_formula_fourth_power_lower_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), f.Valid → f.eval = (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ))) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n) → n ^ 4 ≤ 48 * (2 * Nat.clog 2 n) * f.variableLeaves

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanent_rational_formula_logarithmic_lower_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), f.Valid → f.eval = (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ))) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n) → ↑n ^ 4 / (192 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.variableLeaves

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanent_rational_formula_lower_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), f.Valid → f.eval = (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ))) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.permanentPolynomial n) → ↑n ^ 4 / (192 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.variableLeaves ∧ ↑n ^ 4 / (192 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.leafCount ∧ ↑n ^ 4 / (192 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.vertexCount ∧ ↑n ^ 4 / (384 * Real.logb 2 ↑n) ≤ ↑f.internalGateCount

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.polynomialCoefficientProjection
entries.statement: {K : Type u_1} → {E : Type u_2} → {ι : Type u_3} → [inst : Field K] → [inst_1 : Field E] → [inst_2 : Algebra K E] → (E →ₗ[K] K) → MvPolynomial ι E →ₗ[K] MvPolynomial ι K

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.polynomialCoefficientProjection_map
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra K E] (φ : E →ₗ[K] K), (∀ (a : K), φ ((algebraMap K E) a) = a) → ∀ (p : MvPolynomial ι K), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.polynomialCoefficientProjection φ) ((MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K E)) p) = p

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.polynomialCoefficientProjection_map_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra K E] (φ : E →ₗ[K] K) (q : MvPolynomial ι K) (f : MvPolynomial ι E), (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.polynomialCoefficientProjection φ) ((MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K E)) q * f) = q * (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.polynomialCoefficientProjection φ) f

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.polynomial_intersection_of_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra K E] (f : MvPolynomial ι E) (p q : MvPolynomial ι K), q ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K E)) q * f = (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K E)) p → ∃ g, (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K E)) g = f

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.projectiveMatrixGenerators

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.rational_logarithmic_lower_bound

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.relation_vecMul_jacobianMinor
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} {F : Type w} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (g : ι → MvPolynomial κ F) (cols : ι → κ) (H : MvPolynomial ι F), (MvPolynomial.aeval g) H = 0 → Matrix.vecMul (fun i => (MvPolynomial.aeval g) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) H)) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.jacobianMinor g cols) = 0

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.sum_matchingCrossPermutation
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid F] [inst_1 : Fintype T] [inst_2 : Fintype A] [inst_3 : Fintype B] [inst_4 : DecidableEq A] [inst_5 : DecidableEq B] (w : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.MatchingCrossPermutation T A B → F), ∑ σ, w σ = ∑ rows, ∑ cols, ∑ remainder, w { rows := rows, cols := cols, remainder := remainder }.toPermutation

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.sum_matchingCrossPermutation_rows_cols
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring F] [inst_1 : Fintype T] [inst_2 : Fintype A] [inst_3 : Fintype B] [inst_4 : DecidableEq A] [inst_5 : DecidableEq B], Fintype.card A = Fintype.card B → ∀ (w : (T ↪ B) → (T ↪ A) → F), ∑ σ, w (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingCrossRows σ) (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.matchingCrossCols σ) = ↑(Fintype.card A - Fintype.card T).factorial * ∑ rows, ∑ cols, w rows cols

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_cumulative_iterate_le_degree_product
entries.statement: ∀ (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ), (∀ i < n, Monotone (H i)) → (∀ i < n, ∀ (m : ℕ), (H (i + 1) m + if d i ≤ m then H i (m - d i) else 0) ≤ H i m) → ∀ (M : ℕ), PermanentRollout.affineCumulative^[n] (H n) M ≤ (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, d i) * H 0 M

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_cumulative_mono

entries.statement: ∀ (H : ℕ → ℕ) (d N : ℕ), (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, if d ≤ m then H (m - d) else 0) = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N - d), H m

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_tendsto_shifted_choose_ratio
entries.statement: ∀ (n M₀ : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ↑((m + M₀ + n).choose n) / ↑((m + n).choose n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_cumulative_iterate_regular
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (I : ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (g : ℕ → MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (n : ℕ), I 0 = ⊥ → (∀ i < n, I (i + 1) = I i ⊔ Ideal.span {g i}) → (∀ i < n, IsSMulRegular (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I i) (g i)) → ∀ (M : ℕ), PermanentRollout.affineCumulative^[n] (PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeHilbert (I n)) M ≤ (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (g i).totalDegree) * (M + Fintype.card ι).choose (Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_bot_finrank
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (N : ℕ), Module.finrank ℂ ↥(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece ⊥ N) = (N + Fintype.card ι).choose (Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_factor_finrank_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)}, I ≤ J → ∀ (n : ℕ), Module.finrank ℂ ↥(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece J n) ≤ Module.finrank ℂ ↥(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I n)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_factor_surjective
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (n : ℕ), Function.Surjective ⇑(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredFactor hIJ n)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_mul_injective
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (g : MvPolynomial ι ℂ), IsSMulRegular (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I) g → ∀ (n : ℕ), Function.Injective ⇑(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredMul I g n)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_mul_range_le_factor_ker
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (g : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (n : ℕ), (PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredMul I g n).range ≤ (PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredFactor ⋯ (g.totalDegree + n)).ker

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_piece_eventual_finrank
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) [Module.Finite ℂ (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I)], ∃ n, ∀ (m : ℕ), n ≤ m → Module.finrank ℂ ↥(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I m) = Module.finrank ℂ (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_piece_eventually_eq_top
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) [Module.Finite ℂ (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I)], ∃ n, ∀ (m : ℕ), n ≤ m → PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I m = ⊤

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_piece_exists_eq_top
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) [Module.Finite ℂ (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I)], ∃ n, PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I n = ⊤

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_piece_finite
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (n : ℕ), Module.Finite ℂ ↥(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I n)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_piece_mem_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (n : ℕ) (x : MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I), x ∈ PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I n ↔ ∃ p, p.totalDegree ≤ n ∧ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) p = x

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_piece_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) {m n : ℕ}, m ≤ n → PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I m ≤ PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I n

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_projection_surjective
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (n : ℕ), Function.Surjective ⇑(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredProjection I n)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_filtered_regular_finrank_inequality
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (g : MvPolynomial ι ℂ), IsSMulRegular (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I) g → ∀ (n : ℕ), Module.finrank ℂ ↥(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece (I ⊔ Ideal.span {g}) (g.totalDegree + n)) + Module.finrank ℂ ↥(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I n) ≤ Module.finrank ℂ ↥(PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeFilteredPiece I (g.totalDegree + n))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_hilbert_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)), Monotone (PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeHilbert I)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_total_degree_hilbert_regular_step
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (g : MvPolynomial ι ℂ), IsSMulRegular (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I) g → ∀ (m : ℕ), (PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeHilbert (I ⊔ Ideal.span {g}) m + if g.totalDegree ≤ m then PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeHilbert I (m - g.totalDegree) else 0) ≤ PermanentRollout.affineTotalDegreeHilbert I m

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_triangular_instruction_ideal_eq_graph
entries.statement: ∀ {k q : ℕ} (rhs : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (gate : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ), (∀ (j : Fin q), gate j = (PermanentRollout.affineGateGraphEvaluation gate) (rhs j)) → (∀ (j i : Fin q), Sum.inr i ∈ (rhs j).vars → ↑i < ↑j) → PermanentRollout.affineTriangularInstructionIdeal rhs = PermanentRollout.affineGateGraphIdeal gate

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_triangular_instruction_output_equations_isWeaklyRegular
entries.statement: ∀ {k q : ℕ} (rhs : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (gate : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (output : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (target : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (j : Fin q), gate j = (PermanentRollout.affineGateGraphEvaluation gate) (rhs j)) → (∀ (j i : Fin q), Sum.inr i ∈ (rhs j).vars → ↑i < ↑j) → (∀ (i : Fin k), (PermanentRollout.affineGateGraphEvaluation gate) (output i) = F i) → RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (List.ofFn fun i => F i - MvPolynomial.C (target i)) → RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) ((List.ofFn fun j => MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr j) - rhs j) ++ List.ofFn fun i => output i - MvPolynomial.C (target i))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_triangular_instruction_output_isWeaklyRegular
entries.statement: ∀ {k q : ℕ} (rhs : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (gate : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (output : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (target : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (j : Fin q), gate j = (PermanentRollout.affineGateGraphEvaluation gate) (rhs j)) → (∀ (j i : Fin q), Sum.inr i ∈ (rhs j).vars → ↑i < ↑j) → (∀ (i : Fin k), (PermanentRollout.affineGateGraphEvaluation gate) (output i) = F i) → RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (List.ofFn fun i => F i - MvPolynomial.C (target i)) → RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ ⧸ PermanentRollout.affineTriangularInstructionIdeal rhs) (List.ofFn fun i => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.affineTriangularInstructionIdeal rhs)) (output i - MvPolynomial.C (target i)))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_triangular_instruction_prefix_ideal_eq_graph
entries.statement: ∀ {k q : ℕ} (rhs : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (gate : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ), (∀ (j : Fin q), gate j = (PermanentRollout.affineGateGraphEvaluation gate) (rhs j)) → (∀ (j i : Fin q), Sum.inr i ∈ (rhs j).vars → ↑i < ↑j) → ∀ (n : ℕ), PermanentRollout.affineTriangularInstructionPrefixIdeal rhs n = PermanentRollout.affineGatePrefixGraphIdeal gate n

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_triangular_instruction_prefix_ideal_ofList
entries.statement: ∀ {k q : ℕ} (rhs : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (n : ℕ), Ideal.ofList (List.take n (List.ofFn fun j => MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr j) - rhs j)) = PermanentRollout.affineTriangularInstructionPrefixIdeal rhs n

entries.name: PermanentRollout.affine_triangular_instructions_isWeaklyRegular
entries.statement: ∀ {k q : ℕ} (rhs : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (gate : Fin q → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ), (∀ (j : Fin q), gate j = (PermanentRollout.affineGateGraphEvaluation gate) (rhs j)) → (∀ (j i : Fin q), Sum.inr i ∈ (rhs j).vars → ↑i < ↑j) → RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin q) ℂ) (List.ofFn fun j => MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr j) - rhs j)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.blockIncidencePowerRemainder_aeval
entries.statement: ∀ {b t s d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → d ≤ t → ∀ (coordinate : Fin b × Fin s × Fin t), (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.blockIncidenceIdeal b t s d)) (MvPolynomial.X (coordinate.1, Sum.inr coordinate.2)) ^ (d - 1) = (MvPolynomial.aeval fun row => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.blockIncidenceIdeal b t s d)) (MvPolynomial.X (row.1, Sum.inr row.2))) (PermanentRollout.blockIncidencePowerRemainder b t s d coordinate)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.blockIncidence_adjoin_column_coordinates
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ), Algebra.adjoin (MvPolynomial (PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceBaseIndex b t s d) ℂ) (Set.range fun coordinate => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.blockIncidenceIdeal b t s d)) (MvPolynomial.X (coordinate.1, Sum.inr coordinate.2))) = ⊤

entries.name: PermanentRollout.blockIncidence_ringKrullDim_le_degree
entries.statement: ∀ {b t s d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → d ≤ t → ringKrullDim (PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceCoordinateRing b t s d) ≤ ↑(b * (2 ^ t - 1 + s * (d - 2)))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.blockIncidence_ringKrullDim_le_of_power_reductions
entries.statement: ∀ {b t s d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → ∀ (remainder : PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceColumn b t s → MvPolynomial (PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceColumn b t s) (MvPolynomial (PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceBaseIndex b t s d) ℂ)), (∀ (coordinate : PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceColumn b t s), (remainder coordinate).totalDegree < d - 1) → (∀ (coordinate : PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceColumn b t s), (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.blockIncidenceIdeal b t s d)) (MvPolynomial.X (coordinate.1, Sum.inr coordinate.2)) ^ (d - 1) = (MvPolynomial.aeval fun row => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.blockIncidenceIdeal b t s d)) (MvPolynomial.X (row.1, Sum.inr row.2))) (remainder coordinate)) → ringKrullDim (PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceCoordinateRing b t s d) ≤ ↑(b * (2 ^ t - 1 + s * (d - 2)))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.blockMinorGraphPullback_equation
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ (coordinate : PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceColumn b t s), (PermanentRollout.blockMinorGraphPullback b t s) (PermanentRollout.blockIncidenceEquation b t s d coordinate) = (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑(PermanentRollout.sourceRowBlockVariableEmbedding b t s coordinate.1)) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (coordinate.2.2, coordinate.2.1)) (PermanentRollout.minorSum t s d))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.blockMinorGraphPullback_equation_mem_gradient
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ) (weight : Fin b → ℂ), (∀ (h : Fin b), weight h ≠ 0) → 0 < d → ∀ (coordinate : PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceColumn b t s), (PermanentRollout.blockMinorGraphPullback b t s) (PermanentRollout.blockIncidenceEquation b t s d coordinate) ∈ PermanentRollout.separatedBlockGradientIdeal b t s d weight

entries.name: PermanentRollout.blockMinorGraphPullback_rename

entries.name: PermanentRollout.coeff_columnLinearFormProduct_eq_assignment_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℂ) (rows : Finset (Fin r)), MvPolynomial.coeff (PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent rows) (PermanentRollout.columnLinearFormProduct U) = ∑ assignment, if PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent assignment = PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent rows then ∏ column, U (assignment column) column else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.coeff_columnLinearFormProduct_eq_permanent
entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℂ) (rows : Finset (Fin r)) (rowEquiv : Fin k ≃ ↥rows), MvPolynomial.coeff (PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent rows) (PermanentRollout.columnLinearFormProduct U) = Matrix.permanent fun i j => U (↑(rowEquiv i)) j

entries.name: PermanentRollout.coeff_squareFreeMonomial_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (target removed : Finset ι) (p : MvPolynomial ι ℂ), MvPolynomial.coeff (PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent target) (PermanentRollout.squareFreeMonomial removed * p) = if removed ⊆ target then MvPolynomial.coeff (PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent (target \ removed)) p else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.coeff_squareFree_eq_zero_of_mem_squareZeroIdeal

entries.name: PermanentRollout.coeff_squareFree_mul_of_forall_eq_zero

entries.name: PermanentRollout.coeff_squareFree_variable_sq_mul

entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (assignment : Fin k → Fin r) (row : Fin r), (PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent assignment) row = {column | assignment column = row}.card

entries.name: PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent_equiv_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (rows : Finset (Fin r)) (rowEquiv : Fin k ≃ ↥rows) (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)), (PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent fun column => ↑(rowEquiv (permutation column))) = PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent rows

entries.name: PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent_support
entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (assignment : Fin k → Fin r), (PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent assignment).support = Finset.image assignment Finset.univ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentFiberPartition
entries.statement: {t s : ℕ} → (rows : Finset (Fin t)) → (Fin t → Fin s) → Finpartition rows

entries.name: PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentFiberPartition_mobius_product
entries.statement: ∀ {t s : ℕ} (rows : Finset (Fin t)) (assignment : Fin t → Fin s), ∏ block ∈ (PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentFiberPartition rows assignment).parts, ∑ partition, PermanentRollout.partitionMobius partition = if Set.InjOn assignment ↑rows then 1 else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentFiberPartition_mobius_sum_refinements
entries.statement: ∀ {t s : ℕ} (rows : Finset (Fin t)) (assignment : Fin t → Fin s) [inst : DecidablePred fun fine => fine ≤ PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentFiberPartition rows assignment], ∑ fine, PermanentRollout.partitionMobius ↑fine = if Set.InjOn assignment ↑rows then 1 else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.columnAssignment_image_eq_of_squareFree
entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (assignment : Fin k → Fin r) (rows : Finset (Fin r)), PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent assignment = PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent rows → Finset.image assignment Finset.univ = rows

entries.name: PermanentRollout.columnAssignment_injective_of_squareFree
entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (assignment : Fin k → Fin r) (rows : Finset (Fin r)), PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent assignment = PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent rows → Function.Injective assignment

entries.name: PermanentRollout.columnAssignment_product_eq_monomial
entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℂ) (assignment : Fin k → Fin r), ∏ column, MvPolynomial.C (U (assignment column) column) * MvPolynomial.X (assignment column) = (MvPolynomial.monomial (PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentExponent assignment)) (∏ column, U (assignment column) column)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.complexity_ratio_tendsto_atTop_of_superquadratic
entries.statement: ∀ (complexity : ℕ → ℕ), (∀ (C : ℝ), 0 < C → ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → C * ↑n ^ 2 ≤ ↑(complexity n)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(complexity n) / ↑n ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

entries.name: PermanentRollout.coordinateEsymm_succ_eq_deleted
entries.statement: ∀ {t : ℕ} (u : Fin t → ℂ) (i : Fin t) (q : ℕ), PermanentRollout.coordinateEsymm u (q + 1) = PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymm u i (q + 1) + u i * PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymm u i q

entries.name: PermanentRollout.criticalCoordinateRing
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ → Type

entries.name: PermanentRollout.criticalGradientIdeal_isHomogeneous
entries.statement: ∀ {m d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), P.IsHomogeneous d → Ideal.IsHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin m) ℂ) (PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal fun i => (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) P)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.criticalGradientIdeal_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {m d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → (PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal fun i => (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) P) ≠ ⊤

entries.name: PermanentRollout.criticalLinearSliceIdeal_radical_eq_idealOfVars_of_dimension_le_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {m n d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → ∀ (c : Fin n → Fin m → ℂ), ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ ⧸ PermanentRollout.permanentRolloutHomogeneousLinearSliceIdeal (PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal fun i => (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) P) c) ≤ 0 → (PermanentRollout.permanentRolloutHomogeneousLinearSliceIdeal (PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal fun i => (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) P) c).radical = MvPolynomial.idealOfVars (Fin m) ℂ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.criticalLocus_eq_zeroLocus_pderiv_span

entries.name: PermanentRollout.degree_le_blockRows

entries.name: PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymmPolynomial_eq_alternating
entries.statement: ∀ (t : ℕ) (i : Fin t) (q : ℕ), PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymmPolynomial t q i = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q + 1), (-MvPolynomial.X i) ^ (q - j) * PermanentRollout.partitionFiberCoordinateEsymmPolynomial t j

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eq_squareFreeExponent_support_of_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (rows : Finset ι), ∀ exponent ≤ PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent rows, exponent = PermanentRollout.squareFreeExponent exponent.support

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eq_zero_of_mem_zeroLocus_of_linearCoordinateKernel_of_radical
entries.statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ)) (c : Fin n → Fin m → ℂ), (I ⊔ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => (PermanentRollout.permanentRolloutLinearCoordinateCombination m) (c j))).radical = MvPolynomial.idealOfVars (Fin m) ℂ → ∀ {v : Fin m → ℂ}, v ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ I → (Matrix.mulVecLin c) v = 0 → v = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_aeval_linearCoordinatePolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {k m : ℕ} (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (u : Fin k → ℂ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), (MvPolynomial.eval u) ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun row => PermanentRollout.linearCoordinatePolynomial W row) f) = (MvPolynomial.eval (W u)) f

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_deletedCoordinateEsymmPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {t : ℕ} (u : Fin t → ℂ) (i : Fin t) (q : ℕ), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymmPolynomial t q i) = PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymm u i q

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_linearSubspaceCoordinatePolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {k m : ℕ} (E : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (i : Fin m) (u : Fin k → ℂ), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.linearSubspaceCoordinatePolynomial E i) = E u i

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_linearSubspacePolynomialPullback
entries.statement: ∀ {k m : ℕ} (E : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (u : Fin k → ℂ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), (MvPolynomial.eval u) ((PermanentRollout.linearSubspacePolynomialPullback E) p) = (MvPolynomial.eval (E u)) p

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_minorSum_pderiv_eq_excluded_embeddings
entries.statement: ∀ (t s d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ (point : Fin t × Fin s → ℂ) (i : Fin t) (column : Fin s), (MvPolynomial.eval point) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (i, column)) (PermanentRollout.minorSum t s d)) = ∑ rows ∈ Finset.powersetCard (d - 1) (Finset.univ.erase i), ∑ embedding, ∏ row, point (↑row, ↑(embedding row))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_minorSum_pderiv_eq_incidencePartitionDerivative
entries.statement: ∀ (t s d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ (x : Fin t × Fin s → ℂ) (i : Fin t) (a : Fin s), (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (i, a)) (PermanentRollout.minorSum t s d)) = (MvPolynomial.eval fun j => x (j, a)) (PermanentRollout.partitionDerivative t d i (PermanentRollout.incidenceParameterExtend (PermanentRollout.minorSumPowerParameters t s x)))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_minorSum_pderiv_eq_partitionDerivative
entries.statement: ∀ (t s d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ (point : Fin t × Fin s → ℂ) (i : Fin t) (column : Fin s), (MvPolynomial.eval point) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (i, column)) (PermanentRollout.minorSum t s d)) = (MvPolynomial.eval fun row => point (row, column)) (PermanentRollout.partitionDerivative t d i fun block => (MvPolynomial.eval point) (PermanentRollout.powerSum t s block))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_minorSum_pderiv_source_embeddings
entries.statement: ∀ (t s d : ℕ) (point : Fin t × Fin s → ℂ) (i : Fin t) (column : Fin s), (MvPolynomial.eval point) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (i, column)) (PermanentRollout.minorSum t s d)) = ∑ rows ∈ Finset.powersetCard d Finset.univ, ∑ embedding, ∑ row, if (↑row, embedding row) = (i, column) then ∏ other ∈ Finset.univ.erase row, point (↑other, embedding other) else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_partitionBlockFactor_excluded_columns
entries.statement: ∀ (t s : ℕ) (point : Fin t × Fin s → ℂ) (column : Fin s) {rows : Finset (Fin t)} (partition : Finpartition rows), (MvPolynomial.eval fun row => point (row, column)) (PermanentRollout.partitionBlockFactor (fun block => (MvPolynomial.eval point) (PermanentRollout.powerSum t s block)) partition) = ∏ block ∈ partition.parts, ∑ other ∈ Finset.univ.erase column, ∏ row ∈ block, point (row, other)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_partitionDerivative_eq_excluded_embeddings
entries.statement: ∀ (t s d : ℕ) (point : Fin t × Fin s → ℂ) (i : Fin t) (excluded : Fin s), (MvPolynomial.eval fun row => point (row, excluded)) (PermanentRollout.partitionDerivative t d i fun block => (MvPolynomial.eval point) (PermanentRollout.powerSum t s block)) = ∑ rows ∈ Finset.powersetCard (d - 1) (Finset.univ.erase i), ∑ embedding, ∏ row, point (↑row, ↑(embedding row))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_partitionDerivative_excluded_columns
entries.statement: ∀ (t s d : ℕ) (point : Fin t × Fin s → ℂ) (i : Fin t) (column : Fin s), (MvPolynomial.eval fun row => point (row, column)) (PermanentRollout.partitionDerivative t d i fun block => (MvPolynomial.eval point) (PermanentRollout.powerSum t s block)) = ∑ rows ∈ Finset.powersetCard (d - 1) (Finset.univ.erase i), ∑ partition, PermanentRollout.partitionMobius partition * ∏ block ∈ partition.parts, ∑ other ∈ Finset.univ.erase column, ∏ row ∈ block, point (row, other)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_partitionIncidenceEquation
entries.statement: ∀ (t s d : ℕ) (p : PermanentRollout.IncidenceParameter t) (columns : PermanentRollout.IncidenceColumns t s) (a : Fin s) (i : Fin t), (MvPolynomial.eval (PermanentRollout.incidenceCoordinatePoint t s p columns)) (PermanentRollout.partitionIncidenceEquation t s d a i) = (MvPolynomial.eval (columns a)) (PermanentRollout.partitionDerivative t d i (PermanentRollout.incidenceParameterExtend p))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.eval_powerSum_sub_column_monomial
entries.statement: ∀ (t s : ℕ) (point : Fin t × Fin s → ℂ) (column : Fin s) (block : Finset (Fin t)), (MvPolynomial.eval point) (PermanentRollout.powerSum t s block) - ∏ row ∈ block, point (row, column) = ∑ other ∈ Finset.univ.erase column, ∏ row ∈ block, point (row, other)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.excludedColumnAssignment_partitionMobius_filter_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {t s : ℕ} (rows : Finset (Fin t)) (excluded : Fin s) (assignment : ↥rows → { column // column ≠ excluded }), ∑ partition with ∀ (block : Finset (Fin t)) (hblock : block ∈ partition.parts) (left : Fin t) (hleft : left ∈ block) (right : Fin t) (hright : right ∈ block), assignment ⟨left, ⋯⟩ = assignment ⟨right, ⋯⟩, PermanentRollout.partitionMobius partition = if Function.Injective assignment then 1 else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_actual_slicedGradient_freeAffineCircuit
entries.statement: ∀ {k m : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin m)), ∀ output ∈ circuit.outputs, ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ), ∃ D, D.multiplicationCount = 3 * circuit.multiplicationCount ∧ D.polynomials = List.map (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial (output.eval circuit.values) W A) Finset.univ.toList

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_arithmeticCircuit_polynomial

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_blockTree_leafList
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (labels : List ι), labels ≠ [] → ∃ tree, tree.leafList = labels

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_eventual_source_parameter_bounds
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n ∧ 8 * PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d ≤ n * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ∧ 4 * PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockWidth d * PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d ∧ 8 ≤ PermanentRollout.blockVariables n d

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_high_homogeneousSubmodule_le_homogeneousMapIdeal
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (F : ι → MvPolynomial ι ℂ), (∀ (point : ι → ℂ), (∀ (i : ι), (MvPolynomial.eval point) (F i) = 0) ↔ point = 0) → ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → ∀ (p : MvPolynomial ι ℂ), p.IsHomogeneous n → p ∈ PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal F

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_idealOfVars_pow_le_homogeneousMapIdeal
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (F : ι → MvPolynomial ι ℂ), (∀ (point : ι → ℂ), (∀ (i : ι), (MvPolynomial.eval point) (F i) = 0) ↔ point = 0) → ∃ n, MvPolynomial.idealOfVars ι ℂ ^ n ≤ PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal F

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_injective_inputMap_into_linearCoordinateKernel
entries.statement: ∀ {m k n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Fin m → ℂ), k + n ≤ m → ∃ W, Function.Injective ⇑W ∧ ∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), (Matrix.mulVecLin c) (W u) = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_inputSlice_projective_disjoint_of_criticalLocusDimension
entries.statement: ∀ {m k d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → k ≤ m → PermanentRollout.criticalLocusDimension P ≤ ↑(m - k) → ∃ W, Function.Injective ⇑W ∧ Disjoint (↑(Submodule.projectivization W.range)) (PermanentRollout.projectiveCriticalLocus P)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_inputSlice_projective_disjoint_of_criticalLocus_codimension
entries.statement: ∀ {m k c d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → k ≤ c → k < m → PermanentRollout.criticalLocusDimension P ≤ ↑(m - c) → ∃ W, Function.Injective ⇑W ∧ Disjoint (↑(Submodule.projectivization W.range)) (PermanentRollout.projectiveCriticalLocus P)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_normalized_permanent_affine_specialization_circuit
entries.statement: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.ArithmeticCircuit (Fin n × Fin n)), circuit.polynomial = PermanentRollout.permanent n → ∀ (substitution : Fin n × Fin n → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInput (Fin m)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ) (c : ℂ), c ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.aeval fun ij => (substitution ij).polynomial) (PermanentRollout.permanent n) = MvPolynomial.C c * P → ∃ D, ∃ output ∈ D.outputs, output.eval D.values = P ∧ D.multiplicationCount ≤ circuit.size

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_normalized_permanent_slicedGradient_circuit
entries.statement: ∀ {n m k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.ArithmeticCircuit (Fin n × Fin n)), circuit.polynomial = PermanentRollout.permanent n → ∀ (substitution : Fin n × Fin n → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInput (Fin m)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ) (c : ℂ), c ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.aeval fun ij => (substitution ij).polynomial) (PermanentRollout.permanent n) = MvPolynomial.C c * P → ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ), ∃ D, D.multiplicationCount ≤ 3 * circuit.size ∧ D.polynomials = List.map (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A) Finset.univ.toList

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_outputSlice_projective_disjoint
entries.statement: ∀ {m k d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), P.IsHomogeneous d → ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ), (∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), u ≠ 0 → PermanentRollout.gradientVector P (W u) ≠ 0) → ∃ A, Disjoint (PermanentRollout.projectiveSlicedGradientImage P W) ↑(Submodule.projectivization A.ker)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_slicedGradient_of_criticalLocus_codimension
entries.statement: ∀ {m k c d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → k ≤ c → k < m → PermanentRollout.criticalLocusDimension P ≤ ↑(m - c) → ∃ W A, Function.Injective ⇑W ∧ (∀ (i : Fin k), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i).IsHomogeneous (d - 1)) ∧ ∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0) ↔ u = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_slicedGradient_of_projective_input_disjoint
entries.statement: ∀ {m k d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ), Function.Injective ⇑W → Disjoint (↑(Submodule.projectivization W.range)) (PermanentRollout.projectiveCriticalLocus P) → ∃ A, (∀ (i : Fin k), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i).IsHomogeneous (d - 1)) ∧ ∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0) ↔ u = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_sourceSeparatedBlockMinorSum_slicedGradient
entries.statement: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → 4 * PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockWidth d * PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d → ∀ (weight : Fin (PermanentRollout.blockCount n d) → ℂ), (∀ (h : Fin (PermanentRollout.blockCount n d)), weight h ≠ 0) → ∃ W A, Function.Injective ⇑W ∧ (∀ (i : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d)), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial (PermanentRollout.sourceSeparatedBlockMinorSum n d weight) W A i).IsHomogeneous (d - 1)) ∧ ∀ (u : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d) → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d)), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial (PermanentRollout.sourceSeparatedBlockMinorSum n d weight) W A i) = 0) ↔ u = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_sourceTreeBlock_slicedGradient
entries.statement: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → 4 * PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockWidth d * PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d → ∀ (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree (Fin (PermanentRollout.blockCount n d))), tree.leafList.Nodup → tree.leaves = Finset.univ → ∃ W A, Function.Injective ⇑W ∧ (∀ (i : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d)), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial (PermanentRollout.sourceSeparatedBlockMinorSum n d (PermanentRollout.sourceTreeBlockWeight (PermanentRollout.blockCount n d) d tree)) W A i).IsHomogeneous (d - 1)) ∧ ∀ (u : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d) → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d)), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial (PermanentRollout.sourceSeparatedBlockMinorSum n d (PermanentRollout.sourceTreeBlockWeight (PermanentRollout.blockCount n d) d tree)) W A i) = 0) ↔ u = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_source_block_slicedGradient
entries.statement: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → 4 * PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockWidth d * PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d → ∀ (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (PermanentRollout.blockVariables n d)) ℂ), P.IsHomogeneous d → PermanentRollout.criticalLocusDimension P ≤ ↑(PermanentRollout.blockCount n d * (PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d + PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d * (d - 2))) → ∃ W A, Function.Injective ⇑W ∧ (∀ (i : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d)), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i).IsHomogeneous (d - 1)) ∧ ∀ (u : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d) → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d)), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0) ↔ u = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_source_floor_blockTree
entries.statement: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → ∃ tree, tree.leafList.Nodup ∧ tree.leaves = Finset.univ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.exists_source_parameter_slicedGradient
entries.statement: ∀ {n d dimension : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → 4 * PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockWidth d * PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d → dimension ≤ PermanentRollout.blockCount n d * (PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d + PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d * (d - 2)) → ∀ (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (PermanentRollout.blockVariables n d)) ℂ), P.IsHomogeneous d → PermanentRollout.criticalLocusDimension P ≤ ↑dimension → ∃ W A, Function.Injective ⇑W ∧ (∀ (i : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d)), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i).IsHomogeneous (d - 1)) ∧ ∀ (u : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d) → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin (PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d)), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0) ↔ u = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.finiteDimensional_quotient_of_zeroLocus_finite
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)), (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ I).Finite → Module.Finite ℂ (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ I)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.finiteDimensional_quotient_radical_of_zeroLocus_finite

entries.name: PermanentRollout.finiteFree_complexTargetFiber_finrank
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : Algebra ℂ R] [inst_4 : Algebra ℂ S] [inst_5 : Algebra R S] [IsScalarTower ℂ R S] [Module.Free R S] (φ : R →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ), Function.Surjective ⇑φ → Module.finrank ℂ (S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom)) = Module.finrank R S

entries.name: PermanentRollout.finiteFree_maximalFiber_finrank
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : Algebra R S] [Module.Free R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsMaximal], Module.finrank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) p) = Module.finrank R S

entries.name: PermanentRollout.finite_of_totalDegree_power_reductions
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [Fintype ι] [inst : CommRing B] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra B A] (x : ι → A) (q : ℕ), 0 < q → ∀ (remainder : ι → MvPolynomial ι B), (∀ (i : ι), (remainder i).totalDegree < q) → (∀ (i : ι), x i ^ q = (MvPolynomial.aeval x) (remainder i)) → Algebra.adjoin B (Set.range x) = ⊤ → Module.Finite B A

entries.name: PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum

entries.name: PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum_criticalLocusDimension_le
entries.statement: ∀ {b t s d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → d ≤ t → ∀ (weight : Fin b → ℂ), (∀ (h : Fin b), weight h ≠ 0) → PermanentRollout.criticalLocusDimension (PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum b t s d weight) ≤ ↑(b * (2 ^ t - 1 + s * (d - 2)))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum_criticalLocusDimension_le_of_incidence
entries.statement: ∀ {b t s d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → ∀ (weight : Fin b → ℂ), (∀ (h : Fin b), weight h ≠ 0) → ringKrullDim (PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceCoordinateRing b t s d) ≤ ↑(b * (2 ^ t - 1 + s * (d - 2))) → PermanentRollout.criticalLocusDimension (PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum b t s d weight) ≤ ↑(b * (2 ^ t - 1 + s * (d - 2)))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum_isHomogeneous

entries.name: PermanentRollout.flattened_sourceTreeSeparatedMinorSum_eq_flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ) (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree (Fin b)), (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑finProdFinEquiv) (PermanentRollout.sourceTreeSeparatedMinorSum b t s d tree) = PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum b t s d (PermanentRollout.sourceTreeBlockWeight b d tree)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.floor_sourceTreeSeparatedMinorSum_eq_sourceSeparatedBlockMinorSum
entries.statement: ∀ (n d : ℕ) (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree (Fin (PermanentRollout.blockCount n d))), (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑finProdFinEquiv) (PermanentRollout.sourceTreeSeparatedMinorSum (PermanentRollout.blockCount n d) (PermanentRollout.blockWidth d) (PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d) d tree) = PermanentRollout.sourceSeparatedBlockMinorSum n d (PermanentRollout.sourceTreeBlockWeight (PermanentRollout.blockCount n d) d tree)

entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (j : Fin circuit.program.length), PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitGate circuit j = (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitGraphEvaluation circuit) (PermanentRollout.freeAffineInstructionRhs (circuit.program.get j))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitGraphEvaluation

entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm (Fin k)), (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitGraphEvaluation circuit) (PermanentRollout.freeAffineExtendedForm form) = form.eval circuit.values

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitGraphEvaluation_instructionRhs
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (instruction : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction (Fin k)), (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitGraphEvaluation circuit) (PermanentRollout.freeAffineInstructionRhs instruction) = PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.eval circuit.values instruction

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitGraphEvaluation_reference
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (r : ℕ), (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitGraphEvaluation circuit) (PermanentRollout.freeAffineGateReference r) = circuit.values.getD r 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitInstructionEquation

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitInstructionEquation_degree_product_le
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)), ∏ j, (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitInstructionEquation circuit j).totalDegree ≤ 2 ^ circuit.multiplicationCount

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitInstructionEquation_totalDegree_le
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (j : Fin circuit.program.length), (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitInstructionEquation circuit j).totalDegree ≤ if (circuit.program.get j).isMultiplication = true then 2 else 1

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily
entries.statement: {k : ℕ} → (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) → (Fin k → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm (Fin k)) → (Fin k → ℂ) → Fin (Fintype.card (Fin k ⊕ Fin circuit.program.length)) → MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin circuit.program.length) ℂ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily_degree_product_le
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (output : Fin k → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm (Fin k)) (target : Fin k → ℂ), ∏ i, (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily circuit output target i).totalDegree ≤ 2 ^ circuit.multiplicationCount

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily_isWeaklyRegular
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (output : Fin k → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm (Fin k)) (F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (e : ℕ), 0 < e → (∀ (i : Fin k), (F i).IsHomogeneous e) → (∀ (point : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval point) (F i) = 0) ↔ point = 0) → ∀ (target : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (output i).eval circuit.values = F i) → RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin circuit.program.length) ℂ) (List.ofFn (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily circuit output target))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily_ofFn
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (output : Fin k → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm (Fin k)) (target : Fin k → ℂ), List.ofFn (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily circuit output target) = (List.ofFn fun j => PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitInstructionEquation circuit j) ++ List.ofFn fun i => PermanentRollout.freeAffineExtendedForm (output i) - MvPolynomial.C (target i)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily_span_range
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (output : Fin k → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm (Fin k)) (target : Fin k → ℂ), Ideal.span (Set.range (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily circuit output target)) = (PermanentRollout.affineTriangularInstructionIdeal fun j => PermanentRollout.freeAffineInstructionRhs (circuit.program.get j)) ⊔ PermanentRollout.affineGateRawOutputIdeal (fun i => PermanentRollout.freeAffineExtendedForm (output i)) target

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily_zeroLocus_finite
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (output : Fin k → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm (Fin k)) (F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (e : ℕ), 0 < e → (∀ (i : Fin k), (F i).IsHomogeneous e) → (∀ (point : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval point) (F i) = 0) ↔ point = 0) → ∀ (target : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (output i).eval circuit.values = F i) → (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (Ideal.span (Set.range (PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuitSquareFamily circuit output target)))).Finite

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineCircuit_homogeneousFiberDegree_le_two_pow
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit (Fin k)) (output : Fin k → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm (Fin k)) (F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ) (e : ℕ), 0 < e → (∀ (i : Fin k), (F i).IsHomogeneous e) → (∀ (point : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval point) (F i) = 0) ↔ point = 0) → ∀ (target : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (output i).eval circuit.values = F i) → e ^ k ≤ 2 ^ circuit.multiplicationCount

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineGateReference_mem_vars

entries.name: PermanentRollout.freeAffineGateReference_totalDegree_le_one

entries.name: PermanentRollout.gradientVector_after_embedding_ne_zero_of_projective_disjoint
entries.statement: ∀ {m k : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ) (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ), Function.Injective ⇑W → Disjoint (↑(Submodule.projectivization W.range)) (PermanentRollout.projectiveCriticalLocus P) → ∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), u ≠ 0 → PermanentRollout.gradientVector P (W u) ≠ 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.gradientVector_smul_of_isHomogeneous

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousComponent_mul_of_right_isHomogeneous

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousComponent_mul_of_right_isHomogeneous_of_lt

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_exists_independent_linear_origin_slices
entries.statement: ∀ {t n : ℕ} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ)), Ideal.IsHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin t) ℂ) I → I ≠ ⊤ → n ≤ t → ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ ⧸ I) ≤ ↑n → ∃ c, LinearIndependent ℂ c ∧ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal I c) = {0}

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_exists_independent_linear_zeroDimensional_slices

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_le_idealOfVars_of_ne_top

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_minimalPrime_exists_variable_notMem

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_minimalPrime_isHomogeneous

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_radical_eq_idealOfVars_of_ringKrullDim_le_zero

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_radical_eq_idealOfVars_of_vertex_minimal

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_vertex_not_minimal_of_ringKrullDim_pos

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_singleton_of_ringKrullDim_le_zero

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal_coefficient_span_le_minimalPrime

entries.statement: ∀ {t n : ℕ} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ)), Ideal.IsHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin t) ℂ) I → ∀ (c : Fin n → Fin t → ℂ), LinearIndependent ℂ c → 0 < ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ ⧸ PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal I c) → ∃ x, LinearIndependent ℂ (Fin.snoc c x) ∧ ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ ⧸ PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal I (Fin.snoc c x)) + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ ⧸ PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal I c)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal_exists_independent_zeroDimensional_extension
entries.statement: ∀ {t p : ℕ} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ)), Ideal.IsHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin t) ℂ) I → ∀ (c : Fin p → Fin t → ℂ), LinearIndependent ℂ c → ∀ (q : ℕ), p + q ≤ t → ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ ⧸ PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal I c) ≤ ↑q → ∃ x, LinearIndependent ℂ x ∧ ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin t) ℂ ⧸ PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal I x) ≤ 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.homogeneousLinearSliceIdeal_snoc

entries.name: PermanentRollout.normalizedPermanent_slicedGradient_homogeneousFiberDegree_le_two_pow
entries.statement: ∀ {n m k : ℕ} (circuit : PermanentRollout.ArithmeticCircuit (Fin n × Fin n)), circuit.polynomial = PermanentRollout.permanent n → ∀ (substitution : Fin n × Fin n → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInput (Fin m)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ) (c : ℂ), c ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.aeval fun ij => (substitution ij).polynomial) (PermanentRollout.permanent n) = MvPolynomial.C c * P → ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ) (e : ℕ), 0 < e → (∀ (i : Fin k), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i).IsHomogeneous e) → (∀ (point : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval point) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0) ↔ point = 0) → e ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (3 * circuit.size)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.partitionIncidence_monicReduction_mem
entries.statement: ∀ (t s d : ℕ) (column : Fin s) (i : Fin t), have q := d - 1; have k := ↑(t - q); have a := (-1) ^ q * ↑q.factorial; have embed := fun row => Sum.inr (column, row); have D := fun row => (MvPolynomial.rename embed) (PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymmPolynomial t q row); have E := fun j => (MvPolynomial.rename embed) (PermanentRollout.partitionFiberCoordinateEsymmPolynomial t j); have R := fun row => PermanentRollout.partitionIncidenceEquation t s d column row - MvPolynomial.C a * D row; MvPolynomial.C k * (MvPolynomial.C a * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (-MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr (column, i))) ^ (q - j) * E j + R i) - ∑ row, R row ∈ PermanentRollout.partitionIncidenceIdeal t s d

entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq α] [inst_1 : CommSemiring R] (weight : Finset α → R) (rows : Finset α), ∀ distinguished ∈ rows, ∑ partition, ∏ block ∈ partition.parts, weight block = ∑ selected ∈ (rows.erase distinguished).powerset, weight (insert distinguished selected) * ∑ partition, ∏ block ∈ partition.parts, weight block

entries.statement: {t s : ℕ} → (rows : Finset (Fin t)) → (↥rows → Fin s) → Fin s → Fin t → Fin s

entries.name: PermanentRollout.selectedRowAssignmentExtend_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {t s : ℕ} (rows : Finset (Fin t)) (assignment : ↥rows → Fin s) (defaultColumn : Fin s) (row : ↥rows), PermanentRollout.selectedRowAssignmentExtend rows assignment defaultColumn ↑row = assignment row

entries.name: PermanentRollout.selectedRowAssignmentExtend_injOn_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {t s : ℕ} (rows : Finset (Fin t)) (assignment : ↥rows → Fin s) (defaultColumn : Fin s), Set.InjOn (PermanentRollout.selectedRowAssignmentExtend rows assignment defaultColumn) ↑rows ↔ Function.Injective assignment

entries.name: PermanentRollout.selectedRowAssignment_mobius_sum_refinements
entries.statement: ∀ {t s : ℕ} (rows : Finset (Fin t)) (assignment : ↥rows → Fin s) (defaultColumn : Fin s) [inst : DecidablePred fun fine => fine ≤ PermanentRollout.columnAssignmentFiberPartition rows (PermanentRollout.selectedRowAssignmentExtend rows assignment defaultColumn)], ∑ fine, PermanentRollout.partitionMobius ↑fine = if Function.Injective assignment then 1 else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.selectedRowAssignment_partitionMobius_filter_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {t s : ℕ} (rows : Finset (Fin t)) (assignment : ↥rows → Fin s) (defaultColumn : Fin s), ∑ partition with ∀ (block : Finset (Fin t)) (hblock : block ∈ partition.parts) (left : Fin t) (hleft : left ∈ block) (right : Fin t) (hright : right ∈ block), assignment ⟨left, ⋯⟩ = assignment ⟨right, ⋯⟩, PermanentRollout.partitionMobius partition = if Function.Injective assignment then 1 else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.separatedBlockCriticalCoordinateRing_ringKrullDim_le_incidence
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ) (weight : Fin b → ℂ), (∀ (h : Fin b), weight h ≠ 0) → 0 < d → ringKrullDim (PermanentRollout.SeparatedBlockCriticalCoordinateRing b t s d weight) ≤ ringKrullDim (PermanentRollout.BlockIncidenceCoordinateRing b t s d)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.separatedBlockCriticalFlattenEquiv
entries.statement: (b t s d : ℕ) → (weight : Fin b → ℂ) → PermanentRollout.SeparatedBlockCriticalCoordinateRing b t s d weight ≃ₐ[ℂ] PermanentRollout.criticalCoordinateRing (PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum b t s d weight)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.separatedBlockGradientIdeal
entries.statement: (b t s : ℕ) → ℕ → (Fin b → ℂ) → Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (b * t) × Fin s) ℂ)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.separatedBlockGradientIdeal_map_flatten
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ) (weight : Fin b → ℂ), Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ finProdFinEquiv).toRingEquiv.toRingHom (PermanentRollout.separatedBlockGradientIdeal b t s d weight) = PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal fun j => (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (PermanentRollout.flattenedSeparatedBlockMinorSum b t s d weight)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.separatedBlockMinorSum

entries.name: PermanentRollout.separatedBlockMinorSum_isHomogeneous
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ) (weight : Fin b → ℂ), (PermanentRollout.separatedBlockMinorSum b t s d weight).IsHomogeneous d

entries.name: PermanentRollout.separatedBlockMinorSum_offBlock_pderiv
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ) {h j : Fin b}, h ≠ j → ∀ (i : Fin t) (a : Fin s), (MvPolynomial.pderiv ((PermanentRollout.sourceRowBlockVariableEmbedding b t s h) (i, a))) ((MvPolynomial.rename ⇑(PermanentRollout.sourceRowBlockVariableEmbedding b t s j)) (PermanentRollout.minorSum t s d)) = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.separatedBlockMinorSum_pderiv
entries.statement: ∀ (b t s d : ℕ) (weight : Fin b → ℂ) (h : Fin b) (i : Fin t) (a : Fin s), (MvPolynomial.pderiv ((PermanentRollout.sourceRowBlockVariableEmbedding b t s h) (i, a))) (PermanentRollout.separatedBlockMinorSum b t s d weight) = MvPolynomial.C (weight h) * (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑(PermanentRollout.sourceRowBlockVariableEmbedding b t s h)) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (i, a)) (PermanentRollout.minorSum t s d))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.signed_factorial_powerset
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (others : Finset α), (∑ selected ∈ others.powerset, (-1) ^ selected.card * ↑selected.card.factorial * if (others \ selected).card ≤ 1 then 1 else 0) = if others.Nonempty then 0 else 1

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sliceRank
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sliceRank_le_codimension
entries.statement: ∀ {n d dimension : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → 4 * PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockWidth d * PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d → dimension ≤ PermanentRollout.blockCount n d * (PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d + PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d * (d - 2)) → PermanentRollout.sliceRank n d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockVariables n d - dimension

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sliceRank_lt_blockVariables
