entries.name: PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial
entries.statement: {m k : ℕ} → MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ → ((Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) → ((Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ) → Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℂ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial_eval
entries.statement: ∀ {m k : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ) (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ) (i : Fin k) (u : Fin k → ℂ), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = A (PermanentRollout.gradientVector P (W u)) i

entries.name: PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial_eval_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {m k d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ) (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval 0) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial_isHomogeneous
entries.statement: ∀ {m k d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), P.IsHomogeneous d → ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ) (i : Fin k), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i).IsHomogeneous (d - 1)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.slicedGradient_kernel_avoidance_of_projective_disjoint
entries.statement: ∀ {m k : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ) (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), u ≠ 0 → PermanentRollout.gradientVector P (W u) ≠ 0) → Disjoint (PermanentRollout.projectiveSlicedGradientImage P W) ↑(Submodule.projectivization A.ker) → ∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), u ≠ 0 → PermanentRollout.gradientVector P (W u) ∉ A.ker

entries.name: PermanentRollout.slicedGradient_of_projective_disjoint
entries.statement: ∀ {m k d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ), Function.Injective ⇑W → Disjoint (↑(Submodule.projectivization W.range)) (PermanentRollout.projectiveCriticalLocus P) → Disjoint (PermanentRollout.projectiveSlicedGradientImage P W) ↑(Submodule.projectivization A.ker) → (∀ (i : Fin k), (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i).IsHomogeneous (d - 1)) ∧ ∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0) ↔ u = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.slicedGradient_zero_fiber_of_kernel_avoidance
entries.statement: ∀ {m k d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → P.IsHomogeneous d → ∀ (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), u ≠ 0 → PermanentRollout.gradientVector P (W u) ∉ A.ker) → ∀ (u : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0) ↔ u = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.slicedGradient_zero_iff_mem_kernel
entries.statement: ∀ {m k : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ) (W : (Fin k → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin m → ℂ) (A : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Fin k → ℂ) (u : Fin k → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin k), (MvPolynomial.eval u) (PermanentRollout.slicedGradientPolynomial P W A i) = 0) ↔ PermanentRollout.gradientVector P (W u) ∈ A.ker

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sliced_gradient_logarithmic_bound_of_fiber_cardinalities
entries.statement: ∀ {k d q cardinality : ℕ}, 2 ≤ d → (d - 1) ^ k ≤ cardinality → cardinality ≤ 2 ^ q → ↑k * Real.logb 2 (↑d - 1) ≤ ↑q

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAffineInput
entries.statement: {r s d : ℕ} → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) ℂ → Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) → Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d) → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInput (Fin (r * s))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAffineInput_polynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {r s d : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) ℂ) (row : Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d)) (column : Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)), (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAffineInput U row column).polynomial = PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix r s d (fun i j => MvPolynomial.X (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))) (fun i j => (algebraMap ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin (r * s)) ℂ)) (U i j)) row column

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha
entries.statement: {R : Type u_1} → [CommSemiring R] → (r d : ℕ) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R → Finset (Fin r) → R

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha_algebraMap
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℂ R] {r d : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) ℂ) (omitted : Finset (Fin r)), PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha r d (fun row column => (algebraMap ℂ R) (U row column)) omitted = (algebraMap ℂ R) (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha r d U omitted)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha_eq_permanent
entries.statement: ∀ {r d : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) ℂ) (omitted : Finset (Fin r)) (rowEquiv : Fin (r - d) ≃ { row // row ∉ omitted }), PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha r d U omitted = Matrix.permanent fun i j => U (↑(rowEquiv i)) j

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha_eq_squareZeroCoefficient
entries.statement: ∀ {r d : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) ℂ) (omitted : Finset (Fin r)), omitted.card = d → PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha r d U omitted = (PermanentRollout.squareZeroCoefficient r (Finset.univ \ omitted)) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.squareZeroIdeal r)) (PermanentRollout.columnLinearFormProduct U))

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockColumnEquiv

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantFunction

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantFunction_bijective
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (matching : Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)), (∀ (row : Fin (s - d)), ∃ column, matching (Sum.inr row) = Sum.inl column) → Function.Bijective (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantFunction r s d matching)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantFunction_spec
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (matching : Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)) (row : { row // row ∉ PermanentRollout.sourceBlockSelectedRows r s d matching }), matching (Sum.inl ↑row) = Sum.inr (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantFunction r s d matching row)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantMatchingOf
entries.statement: (r s d : ℕ) → (matching : Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)) → (∀ (row : Fin (s - d)), ∃ column, matching (Sum.inr row) = Sum.inl column) → { row // row ∉ PermanentRollout.sourceBlockSelectedRows r s d matching } ≃ Fin (r - d)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantMatchingOf_spec
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (matching : Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)) (hvalid : ∀ (row : Fin (s - d)), ∃ column, matching (Sum.inr row) = Sum.inl column) (row : { row // row ∉ PermanentRollout.sourceBlockSelectedRows r s d matching }), matching (Sum.inl ↑row) = Sum.inr ((PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantMatchingOf r s d matching hvalid) row)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstant_exists
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (matching : Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)) (row : { row // row ∉ PermanentRollout.sourceBlockSelectedRows r s d matching }), ∃ column, matching (Sum.inl ↑row) = Sum.inr column

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockDataMatching
entries.statement: (r s d : ℕ) → PermanentRollout.SourceBlockMatchingData r s d → Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockDataMatching_injective

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockDataValidMatching

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockGluedFibre
entries.statement: {R : Type u_1} → [CommSemiring R] → (r s d : ℕ) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R → Finset (Fin r) → Finset (Fin s) → R

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockGluedFibre_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r s d : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R) (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (J : Finset (Fin s)), J.card = d → PermanentRollout.sourceBlockGluedFibre r s d X U I J = ↑(s - d).factorial * (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha r d U I * PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMinor r s X I J)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingDataEquiv
entries.statement: (r s d : ℕ) → d ≤ r → PermanentRollout.SourceBlockMatchingData r s d ≃ PermanentRollout.SourceBlockValidMatching r s d

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingData_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r s d : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R) (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R), ∑ data, PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingWeight r s d X U (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockDataMatching r s d data) = ∑ I ∈ Finset.powersetCard d Finset.univ, ∑ J ∈ Finset.powersetCard d Finset.univ, PermanentRollout.sourceBlockGluedFibre r s d X U I J

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingExpansion
entries.statement: {R : Type u_1} → [CommSemiring R] → (r s d : ℕ) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R → R

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingExpansion_eq_sum_glued_fibres
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r s d : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R) (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R), PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingExpansion r s d X U = ∑ I ∈ Finset.powersetCard d Finset.univ, ∑ J ∈ Finset.powersetCard d Finset.univ, PermanentRollout.sourceBlockGluedFibre r s d X U I J

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf
entries.statement: (r s d : ℕ) → (I : Finset (Fin r)) → (J : Finset (Fin s)) → ↥I ≃ ↥J → { row // row ∉ I } ≃ Fin (r - d) → Fin (s - d) ≃ { column // column ∉ J } → Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf_apply_complement
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (J : Finset (Fin s)) (variableMatching : ↥I ≃ ↥J) (constantMatching : { row // row ∉ I } ≃ Fin (r - d)) (onesMatching : Fin (s - d) ≃ { column // column ∉ J }) (row : { row // row ∉ I }), (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf r s d I J variableMatching constantMatching onesMatching) (Sum.inl ↑row) = Sum.inr (constantMatching row)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf_apply_lower
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (J : Finset (Fin s)) (variableMatching : ↥I ≃ ↥J) (constantMatching : { row // row ∉ I } ≃ Fin (r - d)) (onesMatching : Fin (s - d) ≃ { column // column ∉ J }) (row : Fin (s - d)), (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf r s d I J variableMatching constantMatching onesMatching) (Sum.inr row) = Sum.inl ↑(onesMatching row)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf_apply_selected
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (J : Finset (Fin s)) (variableMatching : ↥I ≃ ↥J) (constantMatching : { row // row ∉ I } ≃ Fin (r - d)) (onesMatching : Fin (s - d) ≃ { column // column ∉ J }) (row : ↥I), (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf r s d I J variableMatching constantMatching onesMatching) (Sum.inl ↑row) = Sum.inl ↑(variableMatching row)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf_injective
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (J : Finset (Fin s)), Function.Injective fun data => PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf r s d I J data.1 data.2.1 data.2.2

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf_isValid
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (J : Finset (Fin s)) (variableMatching : ↥I ≃ ↥J) (constantMatching : { row // row ∉ I } ≃ Fin (r - d)) (onesMatching : Fin (s - d) ≃ { column // column ∉ J }) (row : Fin (s - d)), ∃ column, (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf r s d I J variableMatching constantMatching onesMatching) (Sum.inr row) = Sum.inl column

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf_recovered
entries.statement: ∀ (r s d : ℕ) (matching : Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d)) (hvalid : ∀ (row : Fin (s - d)), ∃ column, matching (Sum.inr row) = Sum.inl column), PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf r s d (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockSelectedRows r s d matching) (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockSelectedColumns r s d matching) (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockVariableMatchingOf r s d matching) (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockConstantMatchingOf r s d matching hvalid) (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockOnesMatchingOf r s d matching hvalid) = matching

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf_sum_weight
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r s d : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R) (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (J : Finset (Fin s)), J.card = d → ∑ variableMatching, ∑ constantMatching, ∑ onesMatching, ∏ row, PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix r s d X U row ((PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf r s d I J variableMatching constantMatching onesMatching) row) = ↑(s - d).factorial * (PermanentRollout.sourceBlockAlpha r d U I * PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMinor r s X I J)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf_weight
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r s d : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R) (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (J : Finset (Fin s)) (variableMatching : ↥I ≃ ↥J) (constantMatching : { row // row ∉ I } ≃ Fin (r - d)) (onesMatching : Fin (s - d) ≃ { column // column ∉ J }), ∏ row, PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix r s d X U row ((PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingOf r s d I J variableMatching constantMatching onesMatching) row) = (∏ row, X ↑row ↑(variableMatching row)) * ∏ row, U (↑row) (constantMatching row)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatchingWeight
entries.statement: {R : Type u_1} → [CommSemiring R] → (r s d : ℕ) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R → Fin r ⊕ Fin (s - d) ≃ Fin s ⊕ Fin (r - d) → R

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix_apply₁₁
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r s d : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R) (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R) (row : Fin r) (column : Fin s), PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix r s d X U (Sum.inl row) (Sum.inl column) = X row column

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix_apply₁₂
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r s d : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R) (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R) (row : Fin r) (column : Fin (r - d)), PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix r s d X U (Sum.inl row) (Sum.inr column) = U row column

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix_apply₂₁
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r s d : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) R) (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r - d)) R) (row : Fin (s - d)) (column : Fin s), PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix r s d X U (Sum.inr row) (Sum.inl column) = 1

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sourceBlockMatrix_apply₂₂

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal_branch
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (lam : ℂ) {left right : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι}, Disjoint left.leaves right.leaves → PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal lam (left.branch right) = (1 + lam) * PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal lam left * PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal lam right

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal_leaf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (lam : ℂ) (label : ι), PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal lam (PermanentRollout.BlockTree.leaf label) = 1

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient_and_total_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (lam : ℂ), lam ≠ 0 → 1 + lam ≠ 0 → ∀ (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), tree.leafList.Nodup → (∀ i ∈ tree.leaves, PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient lam tree i ≠ 0) ∧ PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal lam tree ≠ 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient_branch_left
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (lam : ℂ) {left right : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι}, Disjoint left.leaves right.leaves → ∀ {i : ι}, i ∈ left.leaves → PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient lam (left.branch right) i = lam * PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal lam right * PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient lam left i

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient_branch_right
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (lam : ℂ) {left right : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι}, Disjoint left.leaves right.leaves → ∀ {i : ι}, i ∈ right.leaves → PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient lam (left.branch right) i = PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficientTotal lam left * PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient lam right i

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient_eq_zero_of_not_mem
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (lam : ℂ) (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι) {i : ι}, i ∉ tree.leaves → PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient lam tree i = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeFormProduct
entries.statement: {R : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → [Algebra ℂ R] → [DecidableEq ι] → (ι → R) → ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι → R

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeFormProduct_branch
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℂ R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (y : ι → R) (t d : ℕ) (lam : ℂ) (left right : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), PermanentRollout.subtreeFormProduct y t d lam (left.branch right) = PermanentRollout.subtreeFormProduct y t d lam left * PermanentRollout.subtreeFormProduct y t d lam right * ((∑ i ∈ left.leaves, y i) ^ d + (algebraMap ℂ R) lam * (∑ i ∈ right.leaves, y i) ^ d)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeFormProduct_eq_expansion
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℂ R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (y : ι → R) (t d : ℕ), d ≤ t → ∀ (lam : ℂ) (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), tree.leafList.Nodup → (∀ i ∈ tree.leaves, y i ^ (t + 1) = 0) → PermanentRollout.subtreeFormProduct y t d lam tree = ∑ i ∈ tree.leaves, (algebraMap ℂ R) (PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient lam tree i) * (y i ^ (t - d) * ∏ j ∈ tree.leaves.erase i, y j ^ t)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeLinearFormProduct
entries.statement: {R : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → [Algebra ℂ R] → [DecidableEq ι] → (ι → R) → ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι → R

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeLinearFormProduct_eq_expansion
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℂ R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (y : ι → R) (t d : ℕ), 0 < d → d ≤ t → ∀ {ζ : ℂ}, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ d → ∀ (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), tree.leafList.Nodup → (∀ i ∈ tree.leaves, y i ^ (t + 1) = 0) → PermanentRollout.subtreeLinearFormProduct y t d ζ tree = ∑ i ∈ tree.leaves, (algebraMap ℂ R) (PermanentRollout.subtreeCoefficient ((-1) ^ (d + 1) * 2 ^ d) tree i) * (y i ^ (t - d) * ∏ j ∈ tree.leaves.erase i, y j ^ t)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeLinearFormProduct_eq_subtreeFormProduct
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℂ R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (y : ι → R) (t d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ {ζ : ℂ}, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ d → ∀ (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), PermanentRollout.subtreeLinearFormProduct y t d ζ tree = PermanentRollout.subtreeFormProduct y t d ((-1) ^ (d + 1) * 2 ^ d) tree

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeTopProduct_mul_mem_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (y : ι → R) (t : ℕ) {i : ι}, i ∈ s → y i ^ (t + 1) = 0 → (∏ j ∈ s, y j ^ t) * y i = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtreeTopProduct_mul_other_sum_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (y : ι → R) (t : ℕ) (i : ι), (∀ j ∈ s, y j ^ (t + 1) = 0) → (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, y j ^ t) * ∑ j ∈ s.erase i, y j = 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtree_mul_add_pow_eq_of_annihilates
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p x z : R), p * z = 0 → ∀ (d : ℕ), p * (x + z) ^ d = p * x ^ d

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtree_single_surviving_block
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (y : ι → R) (t d : ℕ) {i : ι}, i ∈ s → d ≤ t → (∀ j ∈ s, y j ^ (t + 1) = 0) → (y i ^ (t - d) * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, y j ^ t) * (∑ j ∈ s, y j) ^ d = ∏ j ∈ s, y j ^ t

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtree_topProduct_union_erase_left
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (left right : Finset ι), Disjoint left right → ∀ (y : ι → R) (t : ℕ) {i : ι}, i ∈ left → ∏ j ∈ (left ∪ right).erase i, y j ^ t = (∏ j ∈ left.erase i, y j ^ t) * ∏ j ∈ right, y j ^ t

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtree_topProduct_union_erase_right
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (left right : Finset ι), Disjoint left right → ∀ (y : ι → R) (t : ℕ) {i : ι}, i ∈ right → ∏ j ∈ (left ∪ right).erase i, y j ^ t = (∏ j ∈ left, y j ^ t) * ∏ j ∈ right.erase i, y j ^ t

entries.name: PermanentRollout.subtree_weighted_sum_mul_block_sum_pow
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (y a : ι → R) (t d : ℕ), d ≤ t → (∀ j ∈ s, y j ^ (t + 1) = 0) → (∑ i ∈ s, a i * (y i ^ (t - d) * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, y j ^ t)) * (∑ j ∈ s, y j) ^ d = (∑ i ∈ s, a i) * ∏ j ∈ s, y j ^ t

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sum_deletedCoordinateEsymm
entries.statement: ∀ {t : ℕ} (u : Fin t → ℂ) (q : ℕ), ∑ i, PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymm u i q = ↑(t - q) * PermanentRollout.coordinateEsymm u q

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sum_deletedCoordinateEsymmPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ (t q : ℕ), ∑ i, PermanentRollout.deletedCoordinateEsymmPolynomial t q i = MvPolynomial.C ↑(t - q) * PermanentRollout.partitionFiberCoordinateEsymmPolynomial t q

entries.name: PermanentRollout.sum_powerset_factorial_mul_factorial
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (rows : Finset α), ∑ selected ∈ rows.powerset, selected.card.factorial * (rows \ selected).card.factorial = (rows.card + 1).factorial

entries.name: PermanentRollout.superquadratic_of_logarithmic_degree_bounds
entries.statement: ∀ (complexity : ℕ → ℕ), (∀ (d : ℕ), 3 ≤ d → ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → ↑n ^ 2 * Real.logb 2 (↑d - 1) / 144 ≤ ↑(complexity n)) → ∀ (C : ℝ), 0 < C → ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → C * ↑n ^ 2 ≤ ↑(complexity n)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.supportDim_quotSMulTop_idealQuotient_eq_ringKrullDim_sup
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (x : R), Module.supportDim R (QuotSMulTop x (R ⧸ I)) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I ⊔ Ideal.span {x})

entries.name: PermanentRollout.three_le_blockCount
entries.statement: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → 3 ≤ PermanentRollout.blockCount n d

entries.name: PermanentRollout.three_mul_blockWidth_le_blockRows
entries.statement: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → 3 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockRows n d

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeBlockVector
entries.statement: {r : ℕ} → Finset (Fin r) → Fin r → ℂ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormMatrix
entries.statement: {r : ℕ} → {ι : Type u_1} → [inst : DecidableEq ι] → (blocks : ι → Finset (Fin r)) → (t d : ℕ) → (ζ : ℂ) → (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormVectors blocks t d ζ tree).length) ℂ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormMatrix_quotient_prod
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (blocks : ι → Finset (Fin r)) (t d : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.squareZeroIdeal r)) (PermanentRollout.columnLinearFormProduct (PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormMatrix blocks t d ζ tree)) = PermanentRollout.subtreeLinearFormProduct (fun i => PermanentRollout.squareZeroBlockSum r (blocks i)) t d ζ tree

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormVectors
entries.statement: {r : ℕ} → {ι : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq ι] → (ι → Finset (Fin r)) → ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι → List (Fin r → ℂ)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormVectors_length
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (blocks : ι → Finset (Fin r)) (t d : ℕ), d ≤ t → ∀ (ζ : ℂ) (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), (PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormVectors blocks t d ζ tree).length = tree.leafList.length * t - d

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormVectors_quotient_prod
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (blocks : ι → Finset (Fin r)) (t d : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), (List.map PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm (PermanentRollout.treeLinearFormVectors blocks t d ζ tree)).prod = PermanentRollout.subtreeLinearFormProduct (fun i => PermanentRollout.squareZeroBlockSum r (blocks i)) t d ζ tree

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeNodeVector
entries.statement: {r : ℕ} → {ι : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq ι] → (ι → Finset (Fin r)) → PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι → PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι → ℂ → ℕ → Fin r → ℂ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm
entries.statement: {r : ℕ} → (Fin r → ℂ) → PermanentRollout.SquareZeroAlgebra r

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm_add
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} (left right : Fin r → ℂ), (PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm fun row => left row + right row) = PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm left + PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm right

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm_block
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} (block : Finset (Fin r)), PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm (PermanentRollout.treeBlockVector block) = PermanentRollout.squareZeroBlockSum r block

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm_eq_column
entries.statement: ∀ {r k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℂ) (column : Fin k), (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PermanentRollout.squareZeroIdeal r)) (PermanentRollout.columnLinearForm U column) = PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm fun row => U row column

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm_node
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (blocks : ι → Finset (Fin r)) (left right : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι) (ζ : ℂ) (j : ℕ), PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm (PermanentRollout.treeNodeVector blocks left right ζ j) = ∑ i ∈ left.leaves, PermanentRollout.squareZeroBlockSum r (blocks i) + (algebraMap ℂ (PermanentRollout.SquareZeroAlgebra r)) (2 * ζ ^ j) * ∑ i ∈ right.leaves, PermanentRollout.squareZeroBlockSum r (blocks i)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} (a : ℂ) (vector : Fin r → ℂ), (PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm fun row => a * vector row) = (algebraMap ℂ (PermanentRollout.SquareZeroAlgebra r)) a * PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm vector

entries.name: PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} (indices : Finset ι) (vectors : ι → Fin r → ℂ), (PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm fun row => ∑ i ∈ indices, vectors i row) = ∑ i ∈ indices, PermanentRollout.treeQuotientLinearForm (vectors i)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.tree_leafList_length_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (tree : PermanentRollout.BlockTree ι), 0 < tree.leafList.length

entries.name: PermanentRollout.twice_criticalDimension_lt_blockVariables
entries.statement: ∀ {n d dimension : ℕ}, 3 ≤ d → 6 * PermanentRollout.blockWidth d ≤ n → 4 * PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d ≤ PermanentRollout.blockWidth d * PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d → dimension ≤ PermanentRollout.blockCount n d * (PermanentRollout.powerSumParameter d + PermanentRollout.blockColumns n d * (d - 2)) → 2 * dimension < PermanentRollout.blockVariables n d

entries.name: PermanentRollout.two_mul_blockRows_le
entries.statement: ∀ (n d : ℕ), 2 * PermanentRollout.blockRows n d ≤ n

entries.name: PermanentRollout.vanishingIdeal_origin_eq_idealOfVars
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1}, MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ {0} = MvPolynomial.idealOfVars ι ℂ

entries.name: PermanentRollout.zeroLocus_gradientIdeal_eq_criticalLocus
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℂ), MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal fun i => (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) P) = PermanentRollout.criticalLocus P

entries.name: PermanentRollout.zeroLocus_homogeneousMapIdeal
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (F : ι → MvPolynomial ι ℂ), MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (PermanentRollout.homogeneousMapIdeal F) = {point | ∀ (i : ι), (MvPolynomial.eval point) (F i) = 0}

entries.name: PermanentRollout.zeroLocus_idealOfVars
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1}, MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars ι ℂ) = {0}

entries.name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.eq_monomial_of_unique_weight
entries.statement: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {w : σ → M} {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {m : M} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}, MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w p m → (∀ (b : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) b = m → b = d) → p = (MvPolynomial.monomial d) (MvPolynomial.coeff d p)

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.ContractedSkeleton

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.coeff_mem_intermediateField_C
entries.statement: ∀ {Y : Type u} {Z : Type v} {F : Type w} [inst : Field F] (S : IntermediateField F (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (a : MvPolynomial Z F), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) a ∈ S → ∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α (MvPolynomial.C a)) ∈ S

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.coeff_mem_intermediateField_X

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.coeff_mem_intermediateField_add
entries.statement: ∀ {Y : Type u} {Z : Type v} {F : Type w} [inst : Field F] (S : IntermediateField F (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (p q : MvPolynomial Y (MvPolynomial Z F)), (∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α p) ∈ S) → (∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α q) ∈ S) → ∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α (p + q)) ∈ S

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.coeff_mem_intermediateField_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {Y : Type u} {Z : Type v} {F : Type w} [inst : Field F] (S : IntermediateField F (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (p q : MvPolynomial Y (MvPolynomial Z F)), (∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α p) ∈ S) → (∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α q) ∈ S) → ∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α (p * q)) ∈ S

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.coeff_mem_intermediateField_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {Y : Type u} {Z : Type v} {F : Type w} [inst : Field F] (S : IntermediateField F (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (p q : MvPolynomial Y (MvPolynomial Z F)), (∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α p) ∈ S) → (∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α q) ∈ S) → ∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α (p - q)) ∈ S

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.contractedSkeleton
entries.statement: {Y : Type u} → {Z : Type v} → {F : Type w} → [inst : Field F] → (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula (Y ⊕ Z) F) → 0 < f.yLeafCount → f.ContractedSkeleton

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.contractedSkeletonAdd
entries.statement: {Y : Type u} → {Z : Type v} → {F : Type w} → [inst : Field F] → (f g : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula (Y ⊕ Z) F) → (0 < f.yLeafCount → f.ContractedSkeleton) → (0 < g.yLeafCount → g.ContractedSkeleton) → 0 < (f.add g).yLeafCount → (f.add g).ContractedSkeleton

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.contractedSkeletonAffine
entries.statement: {Y : Type u} → {Z : Type v} → {F : Type w} → [inst : Field F] → {f h : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula (Y ⊕ Z) F} → f.ContractedSkeleton → (A B : MvPolynomial Z F) → h.splitEval = MvPolynomial.C A * f.splitEval + MvPolynomial.C B → h.yLeafCount = f.yLeafCount → h.ContractedSkeleton

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.contractedSkeletonBinary
entries.statement: {Y : Type u} → {Z : Type v} → {F : Type w} → [inst : Field F] → {f g h : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula (Y ⊕ Z) F} → f.ContractedSkeleton → g.ContractedSkeleton → (op : MvPolynomial Y (MvPolynomial Z F) → MvPolynomial Y (MvPolynomial Z F) → MvPolynomial Y (MvPolynomial Z F)) → (∀ (S : IntermediateField F (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (p q : MvPolynomial Y (MvPolynomial Z F)), (∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α p) ∈ S) → (∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α q) ∈ S) → ∀ (α : Y →₀ ℕ), (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Z F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial Z F))) (MvPolynomial.coeff α (op p q)) ∈ S) → h.splitEval = op f.splitEval g.splitEval → h.yLeafCount = f.yLeafCount + g.yLeafCount → 0 < f.yLeafCount → 0 < g.yLeafCount → h.ContractedSkeleton

entries.name: PermanentFormulaLowerBound.Formula.contractedSkeletonBinaryExtras

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.affineForm_gateBound_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) {oldBound newBound : ℕ}, oldBound ≤ newBound → (∀ (index : ℕ), form.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < oldBound) → ∀ (index : ℕ), form.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < newBound

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.affineForm_gateBound_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (coefficient : ℂ) (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (bound : ℕ), (∀ (index : ℕ), form.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < bound) → ∀ (index : ℕ), (coefficient • form).gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < bound

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.affine_inputAdjoints_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint ι) (position : ℕ) (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (input : ι), (state.affine position form).inputAdjoints input = state.inputAdjoints input + MvPolynomial.C (form.inputCoefficients input) * state.gateAdjoints position

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendInstruction
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) → (instruction : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι) → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded circuit.program.length instruction = true → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendInstruction_values
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (instruction : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι) (hvalid : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded circuit.program.length instruction = true), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendInstruction circuit instruction hvalid).values = circuit.values.push (PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.eval circuit.values instruction)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) → (adjoint : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) → (left right : ℕ) → (∀ (index : ℕ), adjoint.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) → left < circuit.program.length → right < circuit.program.length → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts_eval_form
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (adjoint : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (left right : ℕ) (hadjoint : ∀ (index : ℕ), adjoint.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) (hleft : left < circuit.program.length) (hright : right < circuit.program.length) (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι), (∀ (index : ℕ), form.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) → form.eval (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts circuit adjoint left right hadjoint hleft hright).values = form.eval circuit.values

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts_multiplicationCount
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (adjoint : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (left right : ℕ) (hadjoint : ∀ (index : ℕ), adjoint.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) (hleft : left < circuit.program.length) (hright : right < circuit.program.length), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts circuit adjoint left right hadjoint hleft hright).multiplicationCount = circuit.multiplicationCount + 2

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts_program_length
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (adjoint : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (left right : ℕ) (hadjoint : ∀ (index : ℕ), adjoint.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) (hleft : left < circuit.program.length) (hright : right < circuit.program.length), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts circuit adjoint left right hadjoint hleft hright).program.length = circuit.program.length + 3

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts_values
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (adjoint : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (left right : ℕ) (hadjoint : ∀ (index : ℕ), adjoint.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) (hleft : left < circuit.program.length) (hright : right < circuit.program.length), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts circuit adjoint left right hadjoint hleft hright).values = ((circuit.values.push (adjoint.eval circuit.values)).push (adjoint.eval circuit.values * circuit.values.getD right 0)).push (adjoint.eval circuit.values * circuit.values.getD left 0)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts_values_getD_of_lt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (adjoint : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (left right : ℕ) (hadjoint : ∀ (index : ℕ), adjoint.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) (hleft : left < circuit.program.length) (hright : right < circuit.program.length), ∀ index < circuit.program.length, (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts circuit adjoint left right hadjoint hleft hright).values.getD index 0 = circuit.values.getD index 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts_values_left
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (adjoint : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (left right : ℕ) (hadjoint : ∀ (index : ℕ), adjoint.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) (hleft : left < circuit.program.length) (hright : right < circuit.program.length), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts circuit adjoint left right hadjoint hleft hright).values.getD (circuit.program.length + 2) 0 = adjoint.eval circuit.values * circuit.values.getD left 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts_values_right
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (adjoint : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (left right : ℕ) (hadjoint : ∀ (index : ℕ), adjoint.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length) (hleft : left < circuit.program.length) (hright : right < circuit.program.length), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts circuit adjoint left right hadjoint hleft hright).values.getD (circuit.program.length + 1) 0 = adjoint.eval circuit.values * circuit.values.getD right 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.circuit_gateEquation
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (position : Fin circuit.program.length), circuit.values.getD (↑position) 0 = PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.eval circuit.values (circuit.program.get position)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.circuit_values_size
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι), circuit.values.size = circuit.program.length

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.eval_congr_of_referencesBounded
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (instruction : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι) (position : ℕ) (before after : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)), PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded position instruction = true → (∀ index < position, before.getD index 0 = after.getD index 0) → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.eval before instruction = PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.eval after instruction

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.foldl_potential
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (values : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (instructions : List (PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι × ℕ)) (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint ι) (input : ι), (∀ instruction ∈ instructions, values.getD instruction.2 0 = PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.eval values instruction.1) → (List.foldl (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.step values) state instructions).potential values input = state.potential values input

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.forwardFold_gateEquation
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (program : List (PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι)) (values : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)), (∀ (position : Fin program.length), PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded (values.size + ↑position) (program.get position) = true) → ∀ (position : Fin program.length), (List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.forwardStep values program).getD (values.size + ↑position) 0 = PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.eval (List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.forwardStep values program) (program.get position)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.forwardFold_getD_of_lt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (program : List (PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι)) (values : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)), ∀ index < values.size, (List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.forwardStep values program).getD index 0 = values.getD index 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.forwardFold_size
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (program : List (PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι)) (values : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)), (List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.forwardStep values program).size = values.size + program.length

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι), ∀ output ∈ circuit.outputs, ∀ (index : ℕ), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.initial output).gateAdjoints index ≠ 0 → index < circuit.program.length

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.initial_potential
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (output : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (values : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (input : ι), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.initial output).potential values input = (MvPolynomial.pderiv input) (output.eval values)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.linearCombination_erase_add
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (adjoints : κ →₀ MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (family : κ → MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (index : κ), (Finsupp.linearCombination (MvPolynomial ι ℂ) family) (Finsupp.erase index adjoints) + adjoints index * family index = (Finsupp.linearCombination (MvPolynomial ι ℂ) family) adjoints

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (adjoint : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (coefficients : κ →₀ ℂ) (family : κ → MvPolynomial ι ℂ), (Finsupp.linearCombination (MvPolynomial ι ℂ) family) (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.scaleCoefficients adjoint coefficients) = adjoint * (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ family) coefficients

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.potential_affine
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint ι) (values : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (position : ℕ) (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (input : ι), values.getD position 0 = form.eval values → (state.affine position form).potential values input = state.potential values input

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.potential_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint ι) (values : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (position left right : ℕ) (input : ι), values.getD position 0 = values.getD left 0 * values.getD right 0 → (state.mul values position left right).potential values input = state.potential values input

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (program : List (PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι)) (values : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (start : ℕ) (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint ι), (∀ instruction ∈ program.zipIdx start, PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded instruction.2 instruction.1 = true) → (∀ (index : ℕ), state.gateAdjoints index ≠ 0 → index < start + program.length) → ∀ (index : ℕ), (List.foldl (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.step values) state (program.zipIdx start).reverse).gateAdjoints index ≠ 0 → index < start

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (output : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (input : ι), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.run circuit output).potential circuit.values input = (MvPolynomial.pderiv input) (output.eval circuit.values)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.affine_gateAdjoints_eval
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position : ℕ) (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (gate : ℕ), ((state.affine position form).gateAdjoints gate).eval (state.affine position form).circuit.values = if gate = position then 0 else (state.gateAdjoints gate).eval state.circuit.values + MvPolynomial.C (form.gateCoefficients gate) * (state.gateAdjoints position).eval state.circuit.values

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.affine_inputAdjoints_eval
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position : ℕ) (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι) (input : ι), ((state.affine position form).inputAdjoints input).eval (state.affine position form).circuit.values = (state.inputAdjoints input).eval state.circuit.values + MvPolynomial.C (form.inputCoefficients input) * (state.gateAdjoints position).eval state.circuit.values

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.foldl_multiplicationCount
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (instructions : List (PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι × ℕ)) (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι), (∀ instruction ∈ instructions, instruction.2 < state.sourceLength) → (∀ instruction ∈ instructions, PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded instruction.2 instruction.1 = true) → (List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step state instructions).circuit.multiplicationCount = state.circuit.multiplicationCount + (List.map (fun instruction => PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.instructionCost instruction.1) instructions).sum

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.foldl_realizes
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (instructions : List (PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι × ℕ)) (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (adjoints : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint ι) (sourceValues : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)), (∀ instruction ∈ instructions, instruction.2 < state.sourceLength) → (∀ instruction ∈ instructions, PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded instruction.2 instruction.1 = true) → (∀ gate < state.sourceLength, state.circuit.values.getD gate 0 = sourceValues.getD gate 0) → (∀ (input : ι), (state.inputAdjoints input).eval state.circuit.values = adjoints.inputAdjoints input) → (∀ (gate : ℕ), (state.gateAdjoints gate).eval state.circuit.values = adjoints.gateAdjoints gate) → (∀ gate < state.sourceLength, (List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step state instructions).circuit.values.getD gate 0 = sourceValues.getD gate 0) ∧ (∀ (input : ι), ((List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step state instructions).inputAdjoints input).eval (List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step state instructions).circuit.values = (List.foldl (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.step sourceValues) adjoints instructions).inputAdjoints input) ∧ ∀ (gate : ℕ), ((List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step state instructions).gateAdjoints gate).eval (List.foldl PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step state instructions).circuit.values = (List.foldl (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.step sourceValues) adjoints instructions).gateAdjoints gate

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.initial
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι → PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) → ℕ → (left right : ℕ) → left < state.sourceLength → right < state.sourceLength → PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_circuit
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength), (state.mul position left right hleft hright).circuit = PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.appendReverseProducts state.circuit (state.gateAdjoints position) left right ⋯ ⋯ ⋯

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_eval_form
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength) (form : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι), (∀ (index : ℕ), form.gateCoefficients index ≠ 0 → index < state.circuit.program.length) → form.eval (state.mul position left right hleft hright).circuit.values = form.eval state.circuit.values

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_gateAdjoints_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength) (gate : ℕ), (state.mul position left right hleft hright).gateAdjoints gate = ((if gate = position then 0 else state.gateAdjoints gate) + if gate = left then PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm.gate (state.circuit.program.length + 1) else 0) + if gate = right then PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm.gate (state.circuit.program.length + 2) else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_gateAdjoints_eval
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength) (gate : ℕ), ((state.mul position left right hleft hright).gateAdjoints gate).eval (state.mul position left right hleft hright).circuit.values = ((if gate = position then 0 else (state.gateAdjoints gate).eval state.circuit.values) + if gate = left then (state.gateAdjoints position).eval state.circuit.values * state.circuit.values.getD right 0 else 0) + if gate = right then (state.gateAdjoints position).eval state.circuit.values * state.circuit.values.getD left 0 else 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_inputAdjoints_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength) (input : ι), (state.mul position left right hleft hright).inputAdjoints input = state.inputAdjoints input

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_inputAdjoints_eval
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength) (input : ι), ((state.mul position left right hleft hright).inputAdjoints input).eval (state.mul position left right hleft hright).circuit.values = (state.inputAdjoints input).eval state.circuit.values

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_multiplicationCount
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength), (state.mul position left right hleft hright).circuit.multiplicationCount = state.circuit.multiplicationCount + 2

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_new_left
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength), (state.mul position left right hleft hright).circuit.values.getD (state.circuit.program.length + 2) 0 = (state.gateAdjoints position).eval state.circuit.values * state.circuit.values.getD left 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_new_right
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength), (state.mul position left right hleft hright).circuit.values.getD (state.circuit.program.length + 1) 0 = (state.gateAdjoints position).eval state.circuit.values * state.circuit.values.getD right 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.mul_values_getD_of_lt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (position left right : ℕ) (hleft : left < state.sourceLength) (hright : right < state.sourceLength), ∀ gate < state.circuit.program.length, (state.mul position left right hleft hright).circuit.values.getD gate 0 = state.circuit.values.getD gate 0

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι → PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run_inputAdjoints
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι), ∀ output ∈ circuit.outputs, ∀ (input : ι), ((PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run circuit output).inputAdjoints input).eval (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run circuit output).circuit.values = (MvPolynomial.pderiv input) (output.eval circuit.values)

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run_multiplicationCount
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (output : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι), (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run circuit output).circuit.multiplicationCount = 3 * circuit.multiplicationCount

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run_realizes
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (circuit : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineCircuit ι) (output : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineForm ι), (∀ gate < circuit.program.length, (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run circuit output).circuit.values.getD gate 0 = circuit.values.getD gate 0) ∧ (∀ (input : ι), ((PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run circuit output).inputAdjoints input).eval (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run circuit output).circuit.values = (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.run circuit output).inputAdjoints input) ∧ ∀ (gate : ℕ), ((PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run circuit output).gateAdjoints gate).eval (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.run circuit output).circuit.values = (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.run circuit output).gateAdjoints gate

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι × ℕ → PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step_multiplicationCount
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (instruction : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι × ℕ), instruction.2 < state.sourceLength → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded instruction.2 instruction.1 = true → (state.step instruction).circuit.multiplicationCount = state.circuit.multiplicationCount + PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.instructionCost instruction.1

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step_realizes
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (adjoints : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint ι) (sourceValues : Array (MvPolynomial ι ℂ)) (instruction : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι × ℕ), instruction.2 < state.sourceLength → PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction.referencesBounded instruction.2 instruction.1 = true → (∀ gate < state.sourceLength, state.circuit.values.getD gate 0 = sourceValues.getD gate 0) → (∀ (input : ι), (state.inputAdjoints input).eval state.circuit.values = adjoints.inputAdjoints input) → (∀ (gate : ℕ), (state.gateAdjoints gate).eval state.circuit.values = adjoints.gateAdjoints gate) → (∀ gate < state.sourceLength, (state.step instruction).circuit.values.getD gate 0 = sourceValues.getD gate 0) ∧ (∀ (input : ι), ((state.step instruction).inputAdjoints input).eval (state.step instruction).circuit.values = (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.step sourceValues adjoints instruction).inputAdjoints input) ∧ ∀ (gate : ℕ), ((state.step instruction).gateAdjoints gate).eval (state.step instruction).circuit.values = (PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.step sourceValues adjoints instruction).gateAdjoints gate

entries.name: PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint.step_sourceLength
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (state : PermanentRollout.ReverseAdjoint.CircuitAdjoint ι) (instruction : PermanentRollout.FreeAffineInstruction ι × ℕ), (state.step instruction).sourceLength = state.sourceLength
